groups.activity: pledge New Loka (MR 3), earn standing from affinity, Syndicate Alerts and Seeds
groups.meta: 240,000 standing to Flawless plus 100,000 for the weapon

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Pure, 3 at Rank 5 Flawless
rows.alt: Cetus bounties are fastest, Deimos close behind; or a Syndicate Relic Pack, 20,000 standing at Rank 2

conditions: 15% of the affinity you earn while pledged becomes standing, capped per day at 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across the faction syndicates.
Helping Steel Meridian halves New Loka standing and Cephalon Suda zeroes it; falling below a rank's minimum demotes you.
Rank-ups cost 940,000 credits in total, paid once even if you are demoted and re-rank.
bonuses: The three daily Syndicate Alerts (from Rank 1) and their Seeds ignore the cap; a full alert is roughly 10,000 standing.
New Loka feeds The Perrin Sequence +50%; Red Veil touches neither, so rank all three together.

disclosures.title: rank thresholds
disclosures.body: Standing per rank-up is 5,000, 22,000, 44,000, 70,000 and 99,000. Credits and sacrifices per rank: Initiation 10,000 and 1,000 Ferrite, Humane 30,000 and 2 Fieldron Samples, Bountiful 50,000 and a Forma, Benevolent 100,000 and an Orokin Reactor, Pure 250,000 and 2 Aya, Flawless 500,000 and 3 Aya.

disclosures.title: Seeds
disclosures.body: Each alert hides 8 Seeds: one worth 5,000, two worth 1,000, the rest 500 or 1,000, redeemed at the New Loka enclave in a Relay.

conditions: Flawless can't be the free rank-up gift for a syndicate weapon, so you pay the 100,000.
Mastery Rank 10 is required to buy it or receive it in a trade.
